description: This file defines the OpenClawChannelBridge class, which manages communication with a gateway server, handles session messages, approvals, and event filtering for an OpenClaw MCP system.

classes.name: OpenClawChannelBridge
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connection to gateway, handles messaging, approvals, and event filtering for the OpenClaw MCP system.

methods.name: setServer
methods.description: Sets the MCP server instance for the bridge.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes connection to the gateway and subscribes to sessions.

methods.name: waitUntilReady
methods.description: Waits until the gateway connection is fully established and ready.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the gateway connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: listConversations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of conversation descriptors with optional filters.

methods.name: getConversation
methods.description: Fetches a specific conversation by session key.

methods.name: readMessages
methods.description: Reads message history for a session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message in a specified session.

methods.name: listPendingApprovals
methods.description: Returns a list of pending approvals.

methods.name: respondToApproval
methods.description: Resolves an approval request with a decision.

methods.name: pollEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events matching a filter with pagination.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event matching a filter with timeout.

methods.name: handleClaudePermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming Claude permission requests.

methods.name: requestGateway
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway server.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the server.

methods.name: handleHelloOk
methods.description: Handles the 'hello' acknowledgment from the gateway.

methods.name: resolveReadyOnce
methods.description: Resolves the readiness promise once.

methods.name: rejectReadyOnce
methods.description: Rejects the readiness promise with an error.

methods.name: nextCursor
methods.description: Increments and returns the event cursor.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds an event to the queue and notifies waiters.

methods.name: trackApproval
methods.description: Tracks an approval request.

methods.name: resolveTrackedApproval
methods.description: Removes a tracked approval.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway events.

methods.name: handleSessionMessageEvent
methods.description: Processes session message events, including permission replies and message forwarding.

methods.name: shouldEmitClaudeChannel
methods.description: Determines if a message should trigger a Claude channel notification based on mode and role.
